issues.title: State hypotheses before data
issues.body:
## Goal
State hypotheses before data for Momentum Audit, within 8 hours including checks and documentation.

## Steps
1. Define variants, direction, horizon and disconfirming result.
2. Check the product boundary: Research two or three prespecified momentum variants, exposure and cost sensitivity, and all failures. Public factor-series results are educational; an individual-stock alpha claim requires point-in-time universe and delisting data.
3. Record exact commands, versions, seeds, input hashes, failures and actual time.

## Outputs
Future repository artifact: `docs/HYPOTHESES.md`. This planning issue does not claim the artifact exists.

## Acceptance checks
No final holdout is used for design. Evidence includes a reproducible command or reviewable document; no result is manufactured during planning.

## Dependencies
None beyond activation. Read docs/EXECUTION_PLAN.md and docs/IMPLEMENTER_PROTOCOL.md. Prior milestone exits must pass; this candidate remains queued.

## Review evidence
Attach the reviewed diff, exact commands and exit codes, relevant report excerpts, input/config hashes, actual hours and reserve draw. Separate measured outcomes from targets. Done requires review and merge.

## Blocker procedure
Record the smallest failure and missing prerequisite. Keep dependents queued. Use reserve or propose a narrower scope. Unknown rights block distribution; use generated fallback. Escalate budget, intended-use or release changes before crossing them.
